design_decisions.quarantine: IntradayStore.quarantine_symbol_day (manifest status quarantined => IntradayStore.read_rows returns []); detail carries outcome, violations {field, observed, official, tolerance, reason}, source_refs
design_decisions.pass_visibility: sidecar normalized/tw_price_1m_reconciled/<date>/<SYMBOL>.json with real reconciled_at and bar_availability_ts = max(bar_end, fetched_at, reconciled_at); read_reconciled_rows verifies shard hash; minute shards are never rewritten
design_decisions.readmission: only via a later re-fetch that itself passes; sidecar rows + resolved quarantine; original shard kept
design_decisions.waiver: operator + reason required; waived=true, replication_eligible=false, no bar_availability_ts, served only with include_waived=True
design_decisions.pending_vs_missing: official partition for the date absent or row not yet available => pending_official (nothing quarantined, day invisible); partition present but symbol row absent => no_official_row (quarantine)
design_decisions.tick_table: TWSE stock price bands parameterised in config; ETF 0.01 tick below 50 is not modelled (stock table gives the larger tolerance there)
design_decisions.volume_unit_factor: config value 1000 is only an inference (K1 probe: raw KBar x1000 within 1.6-7.9% of official on all 267 rows); recorded in every result as inferred_unverified_not_acceptance, not an acceptance claim
design_decisions.review_fix_round: readmitted/waived sidecars store quarantine_resolved_at/quarantined_at and the loader requires them to equal the current resolved quarantine record; reconcile_symbol_day evaluates resolved readmitted rows instead of reporting already_quarantined; pending outcomes in write mode unlink the pass sidecar
design_decisions.review_fix_round_2: pending on a readmitted day marks the bound sidecar withheld=true instead of unlinking it (quarantine generation is already resolved, so refetch cannot re-run); loader returns [] while withheld; next reconcile with valid official data rewrites the record
